instruction: Change the playback speed in VLC to 1.5x (faster playback).

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC playback speed to 1.5x. Agent can use Playback > Speed menu or keyboard shortcuts (+ key). Custom getter reads <rate> element from VLC HTTP status.xml, metric compares with tolerance of ±0.05.
metadata.verification: VLC playback rate: 1.0 = normal, 1.5 = 1.5x speed. Getter extracts <rate> from status.xml, returns float value.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts playback rate from VLC HTTP interface status.xml <rate> element
Metric properly compares float values with appropriate tolerance (±0.05) for floating-point precision
Expected value of 1.5 is semantically correct for 1.5x playback speed
Complete coverage: instruction requires checking playback speed = 1.5x, evaluator checks exactly this
Data flow is semantically compatible: getter returns float → metric compares float → expected is 1.5
Practical feasibility: VLC HTTP interface is enabled via config, status.xml is standard API, no postconfig needed
Error handling: getter handles exceptions and returns None, metric handles None gracefully
